description.value:
Duration while the duel lasts

They wanted it over. That was the mistake.

Your marked target takes a cumulative −1 circumstance penalty to its attack rolls and AC against you for each round after the third in which the duel has continued, to a maximum of −3. This resets if you mark a different creature, and it does not apply to anyone else in the fight.

cinderfall.incomplete: Cumulative -1 circumstance to the mark's attack rolls and AC against the caster per round after the third, capped at -3, resetting on a new mark. A persistent, incrementing debuff on a different creature's own statistics needs a companion effect applied to that creature, which doesn't exist for this slug -- compounded by the confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
